definitions.explanation: The week before this one; the previous week. Used to refer to events or states in the week that just passed.

examples.japanese: {先週|せんしゅう}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ました→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched a movie last week.

examples.japanese: {先週|せんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金曜日|きんようび}→金曜日：00642_kinyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{会|あ}いました→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I met with a friend last Friday.

examples.japanese: {先週|せんしゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かったです→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There was a lot of rain last week.

examples.japanese: {先週|せんしゅう}⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいません→読む：00426_yomu⟧。⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I haven't read the book I bought last week yet. I don't have time.

examples.japanese: {先週|せんしゅう}⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{美味|おい}しかったです→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{行|い}きたいです→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: The restaurant where I ate with my friend last week was very delicious. I want to go again.

notes:
{先週|せんしゅう} means 'last week' and is part of the time reference system.

TIME SERIES - WEEKS:
- ⟦{先々週|せんせんしゅう}→先々週：noentry⟧: the week before last
- {先週|せんしゅう}: last week
- ⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧: this week
- ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧: next week
- ⟦{再来週|さらいしゅう}→再来週：01416_saraishuu⟧: the week after next

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {先|せん}: previous, before
- {週|しゅう}: week

SIMILAR WORDS WITH {先|せん}:
- ⟦{先月|せんげつ}→先月：00751_sengetsu⟧: last month
- ⟦{先日|せんじつ}→先日：03305_senjitsu⟧: the other day
- ⟦{先年|せんねん}→先年：noentry⟧: years ago

GRAMMAR NOTES:
- Used as time adverb without particle: {先週|せんしゅう}⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧ (I met [them] last week)
- With specific day: {先週|せんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧ (last Monday)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {先週|せんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|まつ}→末：03362_sue⟧: end of last week
- {先週|せんしゅう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: since last week
